name: Single-Page PDF to JSON Converter
description: Deterministic, schema-compliant structural parser extracting text, tables, and metadata.
tagline: A deterministic parser for turning single-page PDF documents into structured JSON.
about: The converter extracts document text, tables, and metadata into a predictable JSON structure, making downstream automation easier to validate and maintain.

steps.desc: Provide a single-page PDF document to the parser.
The utility identifies text, tables, and document metadata.
Download schema-compliant JSON ready for automation workflows.
